_readme: Goal-aware monitor registry for /goal-watch (scripts/goal_watch.py). Each target: name, kind (launchd|artifact|pace), goal (plain-English rubric the judge grades against), evidence (shell commands run from repo root, output fed to the judge), enabled. launchd-kind targets add a launchd `label` and mostly rely on a deterministic launchctl-list check for pass/fail (parsed the same way scripts/heartbeat.py does), with a log-tail command included as extra judge context. Add a target by appending here; goal_watch.py needs no code change for a new evidence-only target.

targets.name: trading-desk
targets.label: com.olivetree.trading-desk
targets.goal: Paper-trading loop stays alive continuously (KeepAlive job) and keeps cycling — a live pid with recent log writes, not wedged or crashed.

targets.name: morning-deal-scan
targets.label: com.olivetree.morning-deal-scan
targets.goal: Runs weekdays 8am, scans buy-box Crexi listings + broker email replies; log fresh within 24h on weekdays.

targets.name: heartbeat
targets.label: com.olivetree.heartbeat
targets.goal: Runs weekdays 7:45am, prints the ops health report, and ntfy-pushes the summary; last run should have exited clean.

targets.name: aios-autocommit
targets.label: com.olivetree.aios-autocommit
targets.goal: Runs daily 9pm and commits any uncommitted repo changes as a git backup; last run should have exited clean.

targets.name: usage-audit
targets.label: com.olivetree.usage-audit
targets.goal: Runs the 1st of each month at 9:05am, mines the last month of sessions, and emails the usage-audit report; last run should have exited clean (only meaningful once/month — a stale last-exit outside day 1 is not itself a failure signal).
evidence: tail -20 ~/Library/Logs/usage-audit.log 2>/dev/null || echo "no log yet — job may not have run since setup"

targets.name: drip
targets.label: com.olivetree.drip
targets.goal: Runs daily 9am and sends any due drip-campaign emails without errors; last run should have exited clean.

targets.name: morning-brief
targets.goal: The 8am cloud routine delivers the Morning Brief email to Brian's inbox every weekday.

targets.name: weekly-cloud-sync
targets.goal: The Friday cloud routines (loom-sync 5pm, pitch-deck-archive 6pm, deal-index/loi-archive 7pm) each write a wiki note and commit to GitHub main WHEN there is new content to archive. A quiet week (no Loom shares, no new decks or LOIs) legitimately produces zero commits — that is ON GOAL, not a failure. Judge OFF GOAL only if the loom dry-run evidence shows content that never landed as commits. Only meaningful to judge Saturday through Monday — say NO DATA the rest of the week, not OFF GOAL, since these routines simply haven't run yet mid-week.
evidence: git fetch origin main --quiet 2>/dev/null; git log origin/main --since='8 days ago' --oneline -- wiki/ | head -20

targets.name: trading-desk-pace
targets.goal: Sell covered-call premium at >= $500/week pace on the $50k paper book (CC_WEEKLY_TARGET_USD); no halt flag active. Judge weekly pace, not a single day — a slow Monday isn't a failure. ($500/wk is the honest stretch: desk ceiling ~$640/wk at normal 1.3% fills; the old $1k/wk was ~104% annualized.)

targets.name: capital-raise-pace
targets.goal: $400K in soft LP commitments by end of Q3 2026 (RAISE_TARGET in scripts/capital_raise.py). Judge pace toward the quarter deadline, not a single day.
evidence: sqlite3 data/olive.db "select coalesce(sum(amount),0) as committed, count(*) as n from investor_commitments where lower(status) in ('soft','funded');"

targets.name: drip-flow
targets.goal: The daily drip worker sends due emails without errors — an empty log on a day with nothing due is fine, an error is not.
